children: Japan's Nikkei share average climbed more than 3% on Tuesday, tracking a sharp rally on Wall Street as Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO rekindled investor enthusiasm for the AI trade.
advanced 3.22% to 58,254.82, rebounding from Friday's 5% decline. The broader Topix
climbed 2.07% to 3,750.45, reversing Friday's nearly 4% drop. Tokyo markets were closed on Monday for a public holiday.
, a bellwether for the AI sector, surged 31.5% overnight in their biggest one-day percentage gain since May 9, 2003.

The chipmaker had announced Huang's resignation on November 12 following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving an alleged Chinese spy, a development that helped trigger last week's global equity selloff.
